c74object.name: mc.ear.decorrelate~
c74object.digest: Decorrelate the channels of a multichannel signal with the BS.2127 decorrelation filters of libear: every channel runs through one of the EAR's random-phase all-pass filters (512 taps, unit magnitude, a fixed random phase per frequency)
c74object.description: Decorrelate the channels of a multichannel signal with the BS.2127 decorrelation filters of libear: every channel runs through one of the EAR's random-phase all-pass filters (512 taps, unit magnitude, a fixed random phase per frequency). With a BS.2051 layout as argument, channel n gets the filter of loudspeaker n, the same one mc.ear.objects~ and ear.objects~ apply to diffuse objects on that loudspeaker, so a bed from mc.ear.direct~ or any signal panned by hand can be widened the way the EAR renders diffuse objects. Without a layout, channel n gets the filter seeded by n, for any number of mutually decorrelated channels. The diffuse attribute mixes the decorrelated signal with a direct share delayed by the filters' compensation delay (255 samples), so both stay time-aligned.

method.name: align
method.description: Set the align attribute. Delay the direct share by the filters' compensation delay (255 samples, as the EAR's renderers delay the direct path) so that it stays time-aligned with the decorrelated signal, whose group delay is that long. Turn off to pass the direct share with no delay.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Post to the Max console which filter each channel gets: the loudspeaker names of the layout, or the channel numbers without one
method.description: Post to the Max console which filter each channel gets: the loudspeaker names of the layout, or the channel numbers without one.

method.name: chans
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Number of channels without a layout, 1 to 1024 (with a layout the count is the layout's). It grows by itself when the input signal carries more channels; a new count takes effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: diffuse
method.description: Set the diffuse attribute. Share of the decorrelated signal in the output, 0 to 1, power-preserving as for an object's diffuse parameter: the decorrelated signal is scaled by the square root of diffuse and the direct share by the square root of 1 - diffuse. 1 (the default) outputs the decorrelated signal alone, 0 the direct share alone.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 layout whose loudspeakers seed the filters (give it as argument): channel n gets the filter the object renderers apply on loudspeaker n of that layout, and the channel count is the layout's. 'none' (the default) seeds channel n by n and takes the count from chans. A change takes effect when the audio is restarted.
